answer: Farming becomes a lantern bet on surviving 45 epochs of grading, and every spiral settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 45 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
